findings.evidence: Decomposition.lean:91-116 versus Basic.lean:1085-1099; the det branch comment "Mathlib defines `LinearMap.det` to be `1` outside finite dimension, so this branch is vacuous and carries no geometric content." appears verbatim in both.
findings.fix: Factor the shared part into one lemma next to `exists_half_turn` in Basic.lean, e.g. `lemma comp_reflect_isKinematicStabilizer (hSymm : g.IsSymm) {a b : V} (ha : g a a ≠ 0) (haq : g K.q a = 0) (haT : g (pTransverse g K) a = 0) (hb : g b b ≠ 0) (hbq : g K.q b = 0) (hbT : g (pTransverse g K) b = 0) : IsKinematicStabilizer g K (Bilin.reflect g a ∘ₗ Bilin.reflect g b) ∧ LinearMap.det (Bilin.reflect g a ∘ₗ Bilin.reflect g b) = 1`, and have both `exists_half_turn` and `exists_quarter_turn` supply only the image computations. That removes ~14 duplicated lines and is roughly line-neutral for Basic.lean's budget, since `exists_half_turn`'s body shrinks correspondingly.
findings.issue: `exists_quarter_turn` re-derives the shared construction of `exists_half_turn` (Basic.lean:1085-1099): both build `Bilin.reflect g a ∘ₗ Bilin.reflect g b` from two `reflect_isKinematicStabilizer` hypotheses, prove `IsKinematicStabilizer` by the same `⟨fun v w => simp [comp_apply, h₁.isometry, h₂.isometry], rw [comp_apply, h₂.fixes_p, h₁.fixes_p], rw [comp_apply, h₂.fixes_q, h₁.fixes_q]⟩`, and discharge `det = 1` by the identical `by_cases hfin` / `LinearMap.det_comp, Bilin.det_reflect, det_eq_one_of_not_module_finite` block, comment included. Only the choice of the second direction (`u'` vs `u - u'`) and the image computations differ.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:370-377 `(lMuNuVA g ε K cV cA).flip = (cV ^ 2 + cA ^ 2) • lMuNu g K - (2 * cV * cA) • lMuNuOdd ε K` with `hOdd` proved inline; Decomposition.lean:212-217 proves the same shape by `LinearMap.ext₂` + `ring`.
findings.fix: Add the general lemma once — e.g. `lemma LinearMap.BilinForm.IsAlt.flip_eq_neg (hA : A.IsAlt) : A.flip = -A` plus `flip_add_smul_of_isSymm_of_isAlt (hS : S.IsSymm) (hA : A.IsAlt) (c : ℝ) : (S + c • A).flip = S - c • A` — in Basic.lean near `IsProperLorentzCovariant.flip`, derive `flip_fromF1F2_add_smul` from it with `fromF1F2_isSymm`, and rewrite `lMuNuVA_flip`'s `hOdd` to use it.
findings.issue: `flip_fromF1F2_add_smul` is the hadronic clone of the existing `lMuNuVA_flip` (Basic.lean:368-377): both state `(S + c • A).flip = S - c • A` for `S` symmetric and `A` alternating, and both inline the missing fact `A.IsAlt → A.flip = -A` (here `rw [← hA.neg_eq v w]`, there `have hOdd : (lMuNuOdd ε K).flip = -lMuNuOdd ε K`). Mathlib has no such lemma either (`Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/Properties.lean` has only `isSymm_iff_flip`, line 128), so the pattern is being written a second time rather than reused.

summary: The mathematics is new and reuses the existing SpectatorPair/ParityOdd/decomposition_unique API well, but two proofs re-derive constructions already present in Tensors/Basic.lean: the composite-reflection stabilizer-plus-determinant argument of exists_half_turn, and the symmetric-plus-alternating flip split of lMuNuVA_flip.
